decisions.reason: Selecting a press-and-dispense control does not change the required mixing quality, foam outcome, whisk selection, or whisk positioning.
The candidate already has a same-message Event capturing the two front press-to-dispense controls and their per-station layout; no additional change is required.
The candidate already has a same-message Event establishing a cursive K on each dispense button.
The press-and-dispense control decision does not change the spout's mounting location, orientation, material, appearance, or pouring access; removability belongs to the cleanability Requirement.
The client specifically requests removable spouts to make cleaning easier, narrowing the prior removable-or-flush cleaning method to removable spouts.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Ok, that sounds and looks good. Are the spouts going to be removable? That would make cleaning them much easier. I like the press-and-dispense button, and I want each button to have a cursive "K".

decisions.reason: The source does not change the existing leak-free connection or bowl-bottom seal requirements.
The selected dispensing control does not modify splash limits or the accepted splash-mitigation methods.
The source accepts the preceding front-panel power-control proposal but does not change the candidate's already recorded control type or location.
The dispensing-button decision does not alter the platform configuration, cup clearance, height, cup size, or footprint.
The source does not change the requirement to isolate electrical components from leaking liquid.
Message 143 specifies a cursive K but does not select its color or otherwise change the established beige-and-green color scheme.
The source accepts a displayed press-and-dispense control but does not request a BOM revision or necessarily change any recorded component selection.
